**Department : CSE(AI\&ML) AY : 2026-27  Date : 02/09/2026** 

**Class: Final Year BTech** 

**Course Name : Soft Computing and Optimization Algorithms (SCOA)** 

**Total FA Marks: 20 Marks** 

**Course Faculty Name : Dr. Anuradha Thakare** 

**Date of Submission : 15th Sept 2026** 

**FA Problem Statement :** Design and develop a Soft Computing/Optimization-based solution for a real-world problem using appropriate datasets and computational techniques, and document the findings in the form of a research article. 

**Soft Computing Techniques/ Algorithms:** Genetic Algorithm, Particle Swarm Optimization, Ant Colony Optimization, Fuzzy Logic, Hybrid algorithms etc. 

**Guidelines for the FA Activity:**

| 1\. Identify Problem- Select a real-world problem and clearly define the objective. 2\. Literature Survey- Study existing research papers, methods, and identify the research gap. 3\. Dataset Selection- Find or create a suitable dataset and justify its selection.  4\. Data Preprocessing- Clean the data, handle missing values/outliers, and perform required transformations.  5\. Select Technique- Choose suitable Fuzzy Logic, GA, PSO, or Hybrid technique based on the problem.  6\. Implementation & Optimization- Implement the selected algorithm and optimize the objective using appropriate parameters.  7\. Evaluation & Comparison- Evaluate the results using suitable performance metrics and compare with a baseline/existing method. |
| ----- |

| 8\. Research Article- Document the problem, methodology, results, discussion, conclusion, and references in a research article. |
| :---- |

**CO Addressed :** 

| Theory Course Outcomes  CO1: Identify Soft Computing techniques and their roles in problem solving.  CO2: Create fuzzy data sets and apply fuzzy inference systems to soft computing applications. CO3: Analyze different strategies for evolutionary computing. |
| :---- |

**Guidelines for Research Article / Paper :**

| ● Prepare a group of 3-4 students.  ● Each group must prepare a research article based on the capstone project.  ● Students should follow a standard academic format such as IEEE format.  ● The article must be based on the student's own implementation and analysis.  1\. Title  2\. Abstract  3\. Keywords  4\. Introduction  4.1 Identification and selection of Softcomputing Method for a chosen problem  5\. Related Research/ Literature Review  6\. Evaluation of Related Research  7\. Proposed Approach/ Solution  7.1 Architecture diagram/ Work flow diagram  7.2 Methodology  7.3 Mathematical Background and Algorithms  7.4 Create Fuzzy dataset and apply Fuzzy Inference Systems  8\. Results and Discussion  8.1 Dataset Description  8.2 Performance Measures  8.3 Experimental Set up  8.4 Statistical Results (Result tables, Graphs)  8.5 Discussions on Results, Findings, Inferences, Comparisons etc |
| :---- |

| 9\. Conclusions  10\. Future Scope  11\. References |
| :---- |
